sources.note: Brief specifies mm for dimensions and kN for force; use mm and kN.
Brief explicitly requests the left half x=0..120 mm of a beam 40 mm deep in y and 40 mm wide in z; domain [120,40,40] mm.
Aluminium 6061 is stated. Brief omits elastic constants; assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity with E=68.9 kN/mm^2 (68.9 GPa) and Poisson ratio nu=0.33.
Brief specifies 1 mm elements; h=1 mm.
Support on bottom edge at left end x=0,y=0 over z=0..40 mm, carrying vertical y and sideways z load only; fix y,z and leave x free.
Brief requests symmetry at mid-span x=120 mm. Reflection symmetry imposes ux=0 on the full cut face, with uy and uz free.
Full 2 kN downward line load lies on the symmetry cut at x=120,y=40,z=0..40 mm. Equal symmetric halves each carry 2/2=1 kN; force [0,-1,0] kN.

final: DONE — Assumed homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity with E = 68.9 GPa and ν = 0.33.

spec.name: Simply supported aluminium beam — left symmetric half

supports.note: Bottom edge at the left end, across the full width; vertical and sideways restraint only.
Symmetry at x=120 mm: displacement normal to the cut plane is zero; tangential displacements are free.

loads.note: Half-model share of the full 2 kN downward mid-span line load: 1 kN total across the full 40 mm width.

spec.description: Left half of 240 × 40 × 40 mm beam; y is up. End support restrains y and z only. Mid-span symmetry restrains x. Half of full 2 kN downward line load is applied at x=120, y=40 across z=0..40. Isotropic linear elasticity assumed.
